spans.notes: OLD_DESIGN: the whole skit is one shot in the older Pudgy design: yellow beaks and yellow feet, paler periwinkle and rose bodies, a glossy shaded sky-blue sofa with white shine marks, on the plain pale grey ground, eye level.
